messages:
maris: quick help—PR #4123 went red in the python unit matrix, looks like intermittent failure in test_http_cache. Can someone kick just the python jobs without rebuilding the docker image?

tanya: yep, we have a lightweight rerun flag. use the internal ci tool: 
```
ci retry --pr 4123 --jobs py-unit --skip-image
```
That will avoid the image build step and only resubmit the specified job(s).

maris: running that now, thanks. will paste output.

ci-bot: request accepted — rerun queued. params: {jobs:["py-unit"], skip_image:true, requested_by:maris, pr:4123} — run_id=98765

jake: FYI if it flakes repeatedly we can do a focused bisect: 
```
ci bisect --pr 4123 --test test_http_cache --base main
```
It will run the test across commits to find the regression window.

sasha: also consider `--preserve-kv-cache` if you want the warm cache to be kept between retries (helps reproduce flaky cache-related failures).

maris: rerun finished — all green :tada: thanks everyone. I'll mark the test flaky on the PR and open a follow-up to proper fix.

tanya: cool, please add the flaky label and link the bisect ticket if it reappears.

maris: done — added label `flake:py-http-cache` and created issue #842 to track root cause. cc @jake for bisect when you have bandwidth.

ci-bot: note — repeated skip-image retries count against the PR retry quota (10/day). Use bisect if you see >3 repeats to avoid wasting CI slots.
